Digest.description: A content digest: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.

RelPath.description: A run-relative POSIX path: non-empty, with no leading `/`, no empty segment, no `.` or `..` segment, no NUL and no `\`.

TreeEntry.description: One path of a run's workspace when the run ended: a file with its content digest, or a directory that holds nothing.

oneOf.description: A file: the store keeps its bytes as the blob `blobs/<hex of sha256>`.

executable.description: Whether the file had an execute bit.

path.description: The run-relative path of the file.

sha256.description: The digest of the file's bytes.

oneOf.description: A directory that holds nothing; a directory with content is implied by its entries.

path.description: The run-relative path of the directory.

description: The workspace of a run when it ended: every file with its content digest and every empty directory, sorted by path, with the version marker `run-tree/1` in `schema`.

entries.description: The entries, sorted by path text without a repeat; no entry lies below a file or below an empty directory.

schema.description: The version marker of the document: always `run-tree/1`.

title: RunTree
